plugins/claude-code-context-advisor/skil: advise.py uses the Python standard library only. It reads one Claude Code session record, chosen by the person or the newest for the current folder, and prints a report of names, counts, sizes and the first 60 characters of a shell command, never file contents. It writes nothing and runs no commands. Tested in scripts/test_advise.py.
plugins/claude-code-guards/hooks: Registers four PreToolUse hooks that only answer ask, deny or nothing, and one PostToolUse hook that only adds a warning beside a web or connector result. None edits files or results, sends data or allows a call the person's settings would block. A failing PreToolUse guard asks rather than allowing.
plugins/claude-code-guards/scripts: Python standard library only. Reads the hook input and, for pushes, runs read-only git commands (remote get-url, rev-parse, log). Writes only an empty per-session marker in the system temp folder. Tested in scripts/test_guards.py.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/hooks: Registers one UserPromptSubmit hook that only warns, or holds one prompt per limit when the person turns hard_stop on, and one Stop hook that only shows a reminder line and never blocks. A failing hook stays silent, so it can never block the person. Neither sends anything or changes a file of theirs.
plugins/claude-code-session-meter/script: Python standard library only. statusline.py runs read-only git commands (rev-parse, rev-list, status) with a 1 second timeout and reads the plugin list and guards overlay. handoff_nudge.py reads the session transcript to count edits. All scripts write only small JSON files named by a hash of the session id in the system temp folder. Tested in scripts/test_meter.py.
plugins/planning-panel/hooks: One Claude Code hooks module (a mod). It registers the update_plan tool and the /plan-panel command, and draws one pane. The tool only writes the plan into the session's own state, with each text capped at 300 characters and each list at 12 items. It reads no files, runs no commands, sends nothing over the network and never gates another tool call. Tested in plugins/planning-panel/tests/panel.test.tsx with claude plugin test.
plugins/private-words/skills/private-wor: scan.py reads the user's list, the repo and its Git log. Its only write is gh secret set, on request, by standard input. It prints no word.
plugins/read-only-researcher/agents: One subagent limited to Read, Grep, Glob, WebSearch and WebFetch, with Bash, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Agent disallowed, so it cannot change files, run commands or delegate.
scripts/autoupdate.py: Not a plugin, but it installs and updates plugins without a person present, so it is recorded here. It runs only when a person turns it on with --install-launchd, and they choose to trust this repo's plugins when they do. Python standard library only. It runs git ls-remote and claude plugin marketplace add/update, list, install and update, and only for the skillknot marketplace, with no shell, so nothing from GitHub becomes a command. It removes nothing and leaves other plugins and settings alone. The job runs a copy made at install time, so a push cannot change the code that runs. The new plugins it installs still pass Claude Code's own install checks, which refuse a command-source install here because no person can confirm it. It writes only its log, its last-commit file, that copy and one LaunchAgent file. Tested in scripts/test_autoupdate.py.
